tests.name: toUnits scalar base currencies splits the amount into a major unit and a remainder
toUnits scalar base currencies returns a plain array when no transformer is provided
toUnits scalar base currencies returns a zero remainder when the amount divides evenly
toUnits scalar base currencies returns [0, 0] for a zero amount
toUnits scalar base currencies treats a scale of 0 as a single, undivided unit
toUnits scalar base currencies supports a base other than 10
toUnits scalar base currencies is consistent with the calculator primitives for negative amounts
toUnits scalar base currencies wrapping the base in a single-element array yields the same result as the scalar base
toUnits multi-base currencies produces one entry per base plus a final remainder
toUnits multi-base currencies resolves every level to zero when the amount is zero
toUnits multi-base currencies scales with the number of base levels
toUnits transformer passes the computed value and currency to the transformer
toUnits transformer returns whatever the transformer returns instead of the raw array
toUnits transformer is not invoked when omitted, returning the raw array
toUnits currying can be reused across multiple dinero objects independently
